snippet.title: Lushfoil Photography Sim VR - Official Launch Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Lushfoil Photography Sim, from solo developer Matt Newell and publisher Annapurna Interactive, is available now for SteamVR as free, optional downloadable content to the base game. First released on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S in April 2025, Lushfoil Photography Sim is a truly immersive experience where players explore real world environments, from the mountainous Italian countryside in Italy to the saltwater West Australian beaches. Complete photography challenges, use different lenses and camera techniques, and capture breathtaking moments. Check out the Lushfoil Photography Sim VR launch trailer to tour beautiful locations and see gameplay.
